fair_value_reason: P/E: NTM non-GAAP EPS at 2027-10-01 ~$10.65 (0.25 x FY27 consensus $9.56 + 0.75 x FY28 ~$11.0) x 34x = $362 (weight 0.6). FCF yield: NTM FCF ~$2.29B (FY26 ~$1.76B after the guided ~$240M capex, grown ~16%/yr) at 2.4% = $95.4B, less ~$0.7B net debt, over 276M diluted shares = $343 (weight 0.4). Blend ~$354. This corrects the ~$1.85B FY26 FCF base used by agents 2, 4 and 5 and agent_2's 2.8% yield, which is inconsistent with its 34x P/E. Net, it equals the forecaster mean of $354.

thesis_triggers.event: Sentiment and a 5.29% 10-year alone took CDNS to $273.96 on Sep 15, 2026 with no company news; the 52-week low is $262.75. $245 is ~7% below that low and ~23x NTM EPS at the horizon (~$10.65), under Synopsys's ~25x FY27. Reaching it most likely needs fundamental damage: an initial FY27 guide well below the usual 10-12% conservative start, backlog falling from $8.1B, visible agent-driven seat or price compression, or China (15% of revenue) lost when the Affiliates Rule suspension ends Jan 10, 2027.

supervisor_summary: After round 2 the five forecasts agree almost exactly: fair values $347-359, mean $354, P(CDNS >= $351 on 2027-10-01) ~0.51. My checks found one real input error: agents 2, 4 and 5 assumed ~$150-160M capex when Cadence guides ~$240M, which overstates their FCF legs. I also found agent_2's 2.8% yield inconsistent with its own P/E. Correcting both on a common basis gives a reconciled fair value of ~$354, so I keep the mean ladder with low confidence. Key swing factors: the Feb-2027 initial FY27 guide (Cadence usually starts low and beats by ~6% on EPS), the multiple under a 5.29% 10-year, the AI-agent narrative (now two-sided after Synopsys's OpenAI and AWS deals), and China's Affiliates Rule date of Jan 10, 2027. Thesis break: $245.
key_drivers: Feb-2027 initial FY27 guide vs consensus FY27 EPS $9.56 / ~13% revenue growth. Cadence's initial guides beat by ~2 pts of revenue and ~6% EPS in FY25 (Feb $6.65-6.75 vs actual $7.14), so a 10-12% initial guide is normal and only a guide well below that breaks the thesis.
Multiple under a 5.29% 10-year: ~30x to ~37x NTM within September with no news; Synopsys at ~25x FY27 even after its +13% investor-day jump. Each 1 turn on ~$10.65 NTM EPS is ~$11/share.
Cash conversion: FY26 OCF ~$2.0B less capex ~$240M (a step-up from $142M) gives FCF ~$1.76B, a ~1.8% yield at spot. The FCF leg supports ~$343, below the P/E leg's ~$362.

AI-agent narrative cuts both ways: Kimi K3 (-9.5% in a day in July) vs the Synopsys-OpenAI revenue-share and AWS royalty deals, which show agent value flowing through incumbent EDA. Cadence has disclosed no agent revenue.
China (15% of Q2 revenue) and the BIS Affiliates Rule suspension ending Jan 10, 2027, just before the Feb guide.
